items: *Mr. A –* I want to know *“if”* they are going to play.
*Mr. B –* He wants to know *“whether”* you are going to play tomorrow.
*Mr. C –* Of course. We’re going to play tomorrow.

blocks.text: Mr. *B* is reporting the question to Mr. *C*.

items: *Mr. A –* Can you tell me whether or not I may invite her to the beach?
*Mr. B –* He wants to know if he can invite you to the beach.

blocks.title: Fill in the Blanks (use whether – if)

items: *Mrs. A –* I want to know ________ I can send you some flowers.
*Mr. B –* He wants to know ________ he can send you some flowers.
*Mrs. A –* I want to know ________ I may buy that expensive dress.
*Mr. B –* She wants to know ________ she can buy that expensive dress.
*Mr. C –* Yes, of course she may.
